expected.php-trait/Rain.php:
<?php
namespace TraitFixture;
trait Rain { public function forecast(): int { return 1; } }
expected.php-trait/Weather.php:
<?php
namespace TraitFixture;
class Weather { use Rain { Rain::forecast as drizzle; } }
expected.php-trait/main.php:
<?php
use TraitFixture\Weather;
function traitfixtureReport(Weather $weather): int { return $weather->forecast() + $weather->drizzle(); }
echo traitfixtureReport(new Weather());
